supplements.title: Inhibition of STAT3-mediated glycolysis by bruceine D suppresses non-small-cell lung cancer progression in vitro and in vivo.
supplements.summary: Bruceine D, a plant compound, slows lung cancer growth by blocking a protein that cancer cells use for energy.

supplements.title: Cepharanthine inhibits lysosomes and induces apoptosis in triple‑negative breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Cepharanthine kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by blocking lysosomes and triggering apoptosis through protein changes.

supplements.title: A preliminary in-vitro and in-silico investigation into the cytotoxic and anti-metastatic activity of Smilax ovalifolia Roxb. ex D.Don against non-small cell lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Smilax ovalifolia plant extract kills lung cancer cells and stops their spread without harming healthy cells.

supplements.title: The role of gut microbiota in thyroid cancer: from pathogenesis to diagnosis and treatment.
supplements.summary: Gut bacteria influence thyroid cancer development, progression, and treatment response, offering potential diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of black elderberry (Sambucus nigra) extract through the role of miR-124-5p and miR-144-5p in a streptozotocin-induced Type 2 diabetic rat model.
supplements.summary: Black elderberry extract protects nerve cells in diabetic rats by activating specific protective molecules.

supplements.title: Redox-mediated activation of PI3K/PTEN pathways by A. baumannii OMV-V. myrtillus conjugate in pancreatic cancer cells.
supplements.summary: A bacterial vesicle-blueberry extract combination kills pancreatic cancer cells by triggering oxidative stress and apoptosis.

supplements.title: Molecular-level host-microbe interactions: mechanisms, molecules, and modeling toward precision probiotics.
supplements.summary: Researchers are mapping how beneficial bacteria molecules work at the molecular level to develop personalized probiotic treatments with precise, targeted effects.

supplements.title: Flavonol-mediated modulation of angiogenesis-related microRNAs in breast cancer: a narrative synthesis of current evidence and knowledge gaps.
supplements.summary: Dietary flavonols may block breast cancer growth by reducing angiogenic microRNAs, though clinical evidence remains limited and requires further testing.

supplements.title: Troxerutin suppresses the stemness of hepatocellular carcinoma via the Syk/FOXO3 feedback loop.
supplements.summary: Troxerutin suppresses liver cancer stem cells by activating a feedback loop between FOXO3 and Syk proteins.

supplements.title: Regular Daily Exercise Improves Sarcopenia in Elderly Patients.
supplements.summary: A 12-week exercise program significantly improved muscle mass, strength, mobility, and reduced inflammation in elderly adults with sarcopenia.

supplements.title: Tumor-targeted liposomal RNAi therapy suppresses breast cancer and modulates tumor microenvironment.
supplements.summary: Engineered liposomes combining targeted delivery, direct toxicity, and VEGF silencing effectively suppress breast cancer growth while boosting immune responses.

supplements.title: Next-generation probiotics: an outlook into current applications and future developments.
supplements.summary: Researchers are developing next-generation probiotics—improved bacterial strains designed to better treat metabolic, immune, and cancer diseases while improving safety.

supplements.title: Effects of Ketogenic Diet on Behavioral, Metabolic, and Peripheral Tissue Changes in a Propylthiouracil-Induced Hypothyroidism Model.
supplements.summary: A ketogenic diet may help reduce behavioral, metabolic, and tissue damage caused by hypothyroidism in animal studies.

supplements.title: Exploring biologically-based complementary and alternative medicine use among Irish cancer survivors: findings from a national survey.
supplements.summary: A survey found that many Irish cancer survivors use unprescribed diets, supplements, and herbal remedies, which can dangerously interact with cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Research progress on the roles and mechanisms of flavonoid monomers in liver diseases: a review.
supplements.summary: Flavonoid compounds from traditional Chinese medicine show promise in treating liver diseases by reducing inflammation, oxidation, and cancer growth.

off_label.title: Chronic stress and cancer progression through neuro‑endocrine‑immune networks (Review).
off_label.summary: Chronic stress may accelerate cancer progression through stress hormone pathways affecting immune function and tumor microenvironment, suggesting psychosocial interventions warrant investigation.

off_label.title: NUPR1 as a central stress-adaptation node in cancer: integrating metabolic rewiring, cell death, and therapy resistance.
off_label.summary: NUPR1 protein helps cancers survive stress and resist treatments by controlling metabolism, cell death, and immunity; blocking it with drugs could overcome resistance.

off_label.title: Akkermansia muciniphila drives viscero-visceral crosstalk via 5-HT3aR-mediated sensitization of dichotomizing gut-bladder neurons.
off_label.summary: A gut bacterium (Akkermansia muciniphila) causes bladder dysfunction by triggering excess serotonin, which could be reversed by blocking serotonin receptors.

off_label.title: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I in intestinal epithelium to promote glycaemic control.
off_label.summary: Metformin lowers blood sugar by blocking a protein in intestinal cells, forcing them to absorb excess glucose and convert it to lactate.

off_label.title: Ketotifen for Preventing Oxaliplatin-Induced Neuropathy in Stage III Colorectal Cancer: a Randomized Controlled Trial.
off_label.summary: Ketotifen may help prevent nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy in stage III colorectal cancer patients.

off_label.title: Losartan Enhances Radiosensitivity by Reversing Immunosuppressive Tumor Microenvironment Induced by Radiotherapy in TNBC.
off_label.summary: Losartan enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in triple-negative breast cancer by reversing immune suppression in tumors.

off_label.title: Ruxolitinib for ciltacabtagene autoleucel-associated refractory diarrhea.
off_label.summary: Ruxolitinib successfully treated severe diarrhea in multiple myeloma patients after CAR T-cell therapy, showing rapid improvement in all treated cases.

off_label.title: Possible Association Between Etanercept Use During Breastfeeding and Infant Somnolence, Hypotonia, and Feeding Difficulties: A Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Etanercept medication in breastfeeding mothers may cause infant drowsiness, weakness, and feeding problems, though more research is needed.

off_label.title: Levetiracetam Reverses Temozolomide Resistance in Glioblastoma by Blocking Drug Efflux through RAB5A/CD63-RAB35 Axis.
off_label.summary: Levetiracetam reverses glioblastoma resistance to chemotherapy by blocking drug efflux, enhancing tumor cell death and survival in mice.

off_label.title: Knowledge Discovery and Drug-Repurposing Framework for Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: Molecular Networking and Computational Docking.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified four druggable protein targets in pancreatic cancer and found existing drugs that may be repurposed to treat it.

off_label.title: Redox-active first-row transition metal complexes of metformin: structure, DNA binding and therapeutic potential.
off_label.summary: Metal-metformin complexes show promise as anticancer drugs by binding DNA and leveraging redox properties to destroy cancer cells.

off_label.title: CDK4/6 inhibition induces a DNA damage-independent senescence-associated secretory phenotype driven by delayed activation of NF-κB
off_label.summary: CDK4/6 inhibitor cancer drugs trigger inflammatory responses through delayed activation of NF-κB, independent of DNA damage.

off_label.title: CKS1B is a tumor-intrinsic factor driving CD8+ T cell exhaustion via maintaining persistent tumor-antigen stimulation.
off_label.summary: CKS1B protein in esophageal cancer tumors exhausts immune cells; blocking it restores anti-tumor immunity and improves checkpoint therapy.

off_label.title: Dutasteride treatment and its effect on standardized uptake values in prostate-specific membrane antigen-PET imaging: A pilot study.
off_label.summary: Dutasteride treatment increased PSMA expression in prostate cancer patients, potentially improving the effectiveness of PSMA-PET imaging for detection.

off_label.title: Enhancing CAR-T Cell Efficacy in Solid Tumors by Inhibiting CCL5/VEGF-Mediated Angiogenesis.
off_label.summary: Blocking CCL5 signaling in CAR-T cells improves their ability to fight solid tumors by preventing unwanted blood vessel growth.

biomarkers.title: Complement-regulated homeostatic proliferation controls memory B cell longevity and repertoire composition.
biomarkers.summary: Complement regulation controls how long memory B cells survive and maintain their diversity through effects on cell proliferation.

biomarkers.title: Ribosomal RNA processing impairments in a B cell immunodeficient patient with WDR75 variants.
biomarkers.summary: WDR75 gene variants impair ribosome production, triggering cellular stress that may cause immunodeficiency and autism spectrum disorder.

biomarkers.title: Bladder stromal tumor of uncertain malignant potential arising in ectopic prostatic tissue: Case report with MRI-pathology correlation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a rare bladder tumor (STUMP) arising from ectopic prostate tissue, expanding understanding of this unusual cancer type.

biomarkers.title: Circulating proteins as biomarkers of response to cancer immunotherapy (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Blood protein markers may help predict which cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy, improving treatment selection.

biomarkers.title: Phosphorylation beyond the plasma membrane: How secretory pathway kinases sculpt the cellular dialogue in cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Secretory pathway kinases regulate cancer cell communication by modifying proteins outside cells, offering new diagnostic and treatment opportunities.

biomarkers.title: A novel regulatory role of microRNA‑5590‑3p in hepatocellular carcinoma via the HOXB2/MYC axis.
biomarkers.summary: MicroRNA-5590-3p suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma growth and spread by blocking the HOXB2 protein and its cancer-promoting effects.

biomarkers.title: Radiotherapy and cytokines: A systems view of immunotherapy and toxicity (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Radiotherapy reshapes immune cell signaling through cytokine networks, offering opportunities to enhance cancer treatment while managing side effects through targeted combinations.

biomarkers.title: Cepharanthine inhibits lysosomes and induces apoptosis in triple‑negative breast cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Cepharanthine kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by blocking lysosomes and triggering apoptosis through protein changes.

biomarkers.title: Ubiquitination mediated cisplatin resistance in bladder cancer.
biomarkers.summary: RAC3 protein drives cisplatin resistance in bladder cancer by boosting glycolysis; blocking it restores drug sensitivity.

biomarkers.title: Evolving Paradigms in the Treatment of Philadelphia Chromosome-Positive ALL.
biomarkers.summary: Philadelphia chromosome-positive leukemia can now be cured without chemotherapy using targeted drugs and antibody-based treatments instead of transplantation.

biomarkers.title: 'Artificial platelet injection system': a plug-and-play platelet-based lysosome-targeting chimera for targeted protein degradation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed artificial platelets that inject proteins into tumor cells, enabling efficient degradation of cancer-related proteins like PD-L1.

biomarkers.title: Assessing the sodium-iodide symporter (NIS) in pediatric differentiated thyroid carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers evaluated how well the sodium-iodide symporter functions in children with thyroid cancer to improve radioactive iodine treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Existential distress in advanced cancer: study protocol of a pragmatic randomized controlled trial of a short-term psychodynamic therapy (ORPHYS) compared to usual psycho-oncological treatment (TAU).
trials.summary: Study tests short-term psychodynamic therapy to reduce existential distress and improve psychological well-being in advanced cancer patients.

trials.title: Maximum safe resection of insular gliomas: update on surgical outcomes from 500 cases.
trials.summary: Surgeons safely removed insular brain tumors using a specific approach while protecting language and motor functions in 500 patients.

trials.title: Pediatric metastatic medulloblastoma: upfront biopsy followed by oncological treatment without excision of the primary tumor.
trials.summary: Skipping surgery on the primary tumor and using biopsy plus chemotherapy and radiation may be effective for metastatic medulloblastoma in children.

trials.title: Ficerafusp Alfa (BCA101) With Pembrolizumab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Two-Year Results of an Expansion Cohort of a Phase I/Ib Trial.
trials.summary: Combining Ficerafusp Alfa with Pembrolizumab improved outcomes in advanced head and neck cancer patients, especially those resistant to standard immunotherapy.

trials.title: Interocular symmetry in dynamic retinal vessel analysis among healthy adults.
trials.summary: This study isn't about cancer research—it examines retinal blood vessel function in healthy adults using eye imaging technology, with no oncology relevance.

trials.title: In vivo reprogramming of cytotoxic effector CD8 T cells via fractalkine-conjugated mRNA-LNPs.
trials.summary: Scientists developed a targeted mRNA therapy that reprograms immune cells to enhance cancer-fighting ability in mice and primates.

trials.title: Antigen spreading mediates heterogeneous solid tumor eradication by DNA demethylating agent-programmed CAR T cells.
trials.summary: DNA-demethylating agents boost CAR T cells to eliminate heterogeneous solid tumors by activating immune responses against antigen-negative cancer cells.

trials.title: From Cells to Targeted Therapy: Cytopathology as the Starting Point of Precision Oncology in the Molecular Tumor Board Workflow.
trials.summary: Cytopathology samples from minimally invasive procedures can reliably guide personalized cancer treatment decisions through molecular tumor boards.

trials.title: Ikaros degradation by mezigdomide reduces T-cell dysfunction and improves the efficacy of antimyeloma T-cell therapies.
trials.summary: Mezigdomide restores myeloma T-cell function by degrading Ikaros, improving CAR-T therapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Optic glioma in children: clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management.
trials.summary: Chemotherapy is the preferred treatment for childhood optic gliomas, particularly in young children and those with NF1, stabilizing tumor growth.

trials.title: Gilteritinib + chemotherapy in children with relapsed/refractory FLT3-ITD AML: results from the phase 1/2 SKIPPER trial.
trials.summary: Gilteritinib combined with chemotherapy achieved 67% remission rates in children with hard-to-treat FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia.
